title: Main Khaak Pe Sojaongi Haan
body:
Sine pe sulane ko
(Akhri raat sakina ki) x2
(Haay haay hay) x3
<<MINI>>
(Me khaak pa sojaungi) x2 ha kehti hu(n) baba
(Sine pe sulane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehti hu(n) ke chehra hi dikhajayiye baba
Marne se mere pehle hi aajayiye baba
<<MINI>>
Pehlu me chhupane ko kaha keti hu(n) baba
Me khaak pa sojaungi, ha kehti hu(n) baba
Sine pe sulane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Bache to bohot chhote huwa karte hai baba
Har aik musibat pe gila karte hai baba
<<MINI>>
Me naaz uthane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
Me khaak pa sojaungi, ha kehti hu(n) baba
Sine pe sulane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Sehlungi jo haathon ki lakiron me likha hai
Zindaan ki andheron ka gila kisne kiya hai
Me shamme jalane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<MINI>>
Me khaak pa sojaungi, ha kehti hu(n) baba
Sine pe sulane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye baba, baba mere bachpan ka taqaza to nahi tha
Khabon me khilone the janaza to nahi tha
Ghodi me khilane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<MINI>>
Me khaak pa sojaungi, ha kehti hu(n) baba
Sine pe sulane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba mere zakhmon ki dawa kon karega
Ab jaan sakina ko bhala kon kahega
<<MINI>>
Pehlu me chhupane ko kaha keti hu(n) baba
Me khaak pa sojaungi, ha kehti hu(n) baba
Sine pe sulane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaan ki andheron me sula kyun nahi dete
Baba mujhe marne ki dua kyun nahi dete
<<MINI>>
Me lori sunaneko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
Me khaak pa sojaungi, ha kehti hu(n) baba
Sine pe sulane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi bhi nahi aansu mere ponchne wala
Sarpe nahi hathon ko koi pherne wala
<<MINI>>
Bahon me chupane ko kaha kehti hun baba
Me khaak pa sojaungi, ha kehti hu(n) baba
Sine pe sulane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye baba, marjawu agar baba tera shaam ho aana
Bimar akela hai janaze ko uthana
Godi me uthane ko kaha kehtu hu(n) baba
<<MINI>>
Me khaak pa sojaungi, ha kehti hu(n) baba
Sine pe sulane ko kaha kehti hu(n) baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Arman sakina ki yahi bayn the haaye
Me kehti rahi baba magar aap na aye
Turbat bhi banane ko kaha keti hu(n) baba
<<MINI>>
Me khaak pa sojaungi, ha kehti hu(n) baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba ko rone wali sine pe sone wali (sakina guzar gayi) x3
